description: This file implements a lexer for parsing D-Bus variant data types, including token definitions, lexer logic, and parsing functions.

classes.name: varToken
classes.description: Represents a token with type and value.

classes.name: varTokenType
classes.description: Byte type defining different token kinds.

classes.name: varLexer
classes.description: Lexer structure holding input string and tokenization state.

methods.name: varLex
methods.description: Initializes lexer and tokenizes input string.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a valid rune from input if present.

methods.name: backup
methods.description: Moves lexer position back by last rune width.

methods.name: emit
methods.description: Emits a token of specified type.

methods.name: errorf
methods.description: Creates an error token with formatted message.

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Peeks at next rune without advancing position.

methods.name: varLexNormal
methods.description: Main lexer state handling normal token parsing.
